reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Silky-Fit Sun Stick 20g
reviews.text: It’s hard to put sunscreen on during the day, specially when I don’t really want to touch my face so much while running errands but this stick makes it so easy to reapply sunscreen. Love it as well because it does not give me any break outs or make my face feel creasy!
reviews.zh: 日間搽防曬其實幾麻煩，尤其係我出街辦事嗰陣唔想成日掂自己塊面，但呢枝防曬棒令補防曬變得好簡單。我都好鍾意佢，因為完全冇令我爆瘡，塊面又唔會覺得油笠！

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Silky-Fit Sun Stick 20g
reviews.text: This Sun Stick is one of the best sunscreens I have ever used. It is non-sticky and quickly absorbs into the skin, making it perfect for daily use. The sun stick is easy to apply, it feels silky and smooth finish without any greasy residue. For sun protection it feel lightweight and comfortable on the skin. Additionally, the hyaluronic and cica helps to soothe and hydrate the skin. I highly recommend this sun stick to anyone looking for an effective and convenient sunscreen.
reviews.zh: 呢枝防曬棒係我用過最好嘅防曬之一。唔黐笠，而且好快就吸收曬，好適合日日用。支防曬棒好易搽，質地絲滑貼服，唔會留低任何油笠嘅殘留感。防曬方面，搽上面感覺輕盈又舒服。另外，透明質酸同積雪草有助舒緩和保濕皮膚。強烈推薦畀所有想搵一枝有效又方便嘅防曬嘅人。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Silky-Fit Sun Stick 20g
reviews.text: Perfect middle of the road sunscreen stick for dry/normal skin. Goes on silky like a powdery solid, but there's no powder, it melts just enough to give you coverage. This skin1004 one is not as glowy/greasy as the shiseido sunstick and it's not as matte as the beauty of joseon sunstick.
reviews.zh: 中規中矩嘅防曬棒，啱乾性／中性肌。搽上去好似粉狀固體咁絲滑，但又冇粉，溶化得剛剛好，可以均勻覆蓋皮膚。呢枝 skin1004 嘅無 shiseido 防曬棒咁水光或油笠，亦都無 Beauty of Joseon 防曬棒咁霧面。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Silky-Fit Sun Stick 20g
reviews.text: Best sunscreen I’ve ever tried/first Korean sunscreen I’ve tried too. It feels so lightweight, used it on top of creasing 8hrs old concealer and it didn’t take off my makeup. I hate the feeling of creams and skin care products that are too think or stick and this one is so soft on the skin it’s amazing even my little brother who’s on the autism spectrum and that hates the feel of almost everything loves it, it’s must try. The one downside is the size. It’s quite small which disappointed me but the formula is so good that I only regret not buying more ‼️
reviews.zh: 我用過最好嘅防曬／亦都係我第一枝韓國防曬。質地超輕盈，我喺已經卡粉 8 個鐘嘅遮瑕上面用，佢都冇抹走我嘅妝。我好怕嗰種太厚或者太黐嘅護膚品，但呢枝搽上面好柔軟，真係好神奇，連我個細佬（佢有自閉症譜系，對幾乎所有嘢嘅觸感都抗拒）都鍾意，呢枝真係必試。唯一缺點係容量太細，令我有啲失望，但配方實在太好，我淨係後悔冇買多幾枝 ‼️

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Silky-Fit Sun Stick 20g
reviews.text: Excelente producto, lo ordene dos veces uno para mi sobrina y otro para mi y ambas estamos muy contentas con el producto. Lo utilizamos para retoques y es súper fácil y cómodo de usar y deja la piel muy suave y aterciopelada, no tiene ningún aroma.
reviews.zh: 產品好正，我落咗兩次單，一個畀我姪女，一個畀自己，我哋兩個都用得好滿意。我哋用佢補妝，超級易用又舒服，用完皮膚好滑好似絲絨，冇任何味道。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Silky-Fit Sun Stick 20g
reviews.text: Primero intenté con el otro bloqueador de la foto y quise intentar con otra más barato, comparándolos el de SKIN tiene 20g, mientra que el de la otra marca tiene un gramo más y es más caro. Mientras que la otra marca la sentí un poco más aceitosa y la absorción es más difícil, la de SKIN es mucho más fácil y el acabado que deja es un poco brilloso pero sin llegar a ser aceitoso.
reviews.zh: 一開始我用咗相入面另一支防曬，之後想試下平啲嘅。比較之下，SKIN 嗰支係 20g，而另一個牌子多 1g，但價錢仲貴過佢。另一個牌子我用落覺得油笠啲，又難吸收，SKIN 嗰支就易用好多，搽完個妝效有少少光澤但又未至於油笠。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Silky-Fit Sun Stick 20g
reviews.text:
Its hit and miss for me. They say sweat and sports proof... with this it made me.sweat and become more oily. It actually felt more heavy than the sun cream. Wore this in summer too. I dont think i will repurchase..
I have dehydrated, oily and sensitive skin.
reviews.zh:
對我嚟講真係時好時壞。佢哋話防汗又防運動……但我用咗反而令我標汗仲多咗油。感覺上仲重過防曬霜。夏天都試過用。應該唔會再回購。
我係缺水性油性敏感肌。

reviews.shade: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Hyalu-Cica Silky-Fit Sun Stick 20g
reviews.text: Wow i think i like this better than the BOJ sunscreen stick! The finish is very comfortable and it doesn’t drag on the skin. It’s also sweat resistant which is always a plus! The only downside is that it feels like you use so much so fast, you could finish it pretty quickly.
reviews.zh: 嘩，我覺得呢枝好用過 BOJ 嘅防曬棒！妝效好舒服，又唔會黐住皮膚扯住痛。仲有防汗功能，永遠都係加分位！唯一缺點係感覺用得好快，好快就會用完。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
